delta_app is deployed and running at https://delta-docs.rehearsal.invalid (deployed today, 2026-10-09 at 14:27). Only the tests step is left, and to finish it I need you to name an email address.

2. A six-digit code arrives in that inbox within about a minute. It works for 10 minutes.
3. Paste just the six digits here. The sign-in it gives me is kept in a private file and never shown. Then I re-run the skipped checks.
